description: Fixed 2-level taxonomy for postit content classification. The LLM is constrained to pick 1-3 leaf slugs from this list; it CANNOT invent new categories. To add a category: edit this file, bump version, run `npm run taxonomy:seed`, and optionally run a reclassify job for items with low-confidence old assignments.
